svg.text: Degrade to absent. Prefer the boring mechanism.

g.text: P7 · GRACEFUL DEGRADATION
Model host down, embedding model missing, vector
store gone → a clean no-op: hidden panel, empty
context section, clear 503. Never a crash, a queue
backup, or a data-loss path.
Retrieval returns [] on any failure; embed calls
return None and retry next tick.
This is what makes default-ON safe: no-LLM sites
pay a cheap no-op; LLM sites get it zero-config.
P8 · DETERMINISTIC FIRST, MODEL SECOND
Where a structured mechanism can answer, use it
before the statistical one:
• playbook matching: trigger conditions first
(rules / ATT&CK) — similarity only as fallback
• prompt-template choice: a 5-tier deterministic
matcher, not a classifier
Deterministic paths are auditable, exactly testable,
free — and they work when the model host doesn't.
Retrieval / quality layers default ON — safe because degradation is proven. New surfaces (AI tool endpoints,
telemetry export) default OFF — closed until an operator deliberately opens them. And pin by test that a feature's
per-call gate and its background-loop gate share one default — they drifted once, and the loop spun while calls no-op'd.
